newsitem.title: USA: Northwest cargo traffic down in Dec and year.
newsitem.headline: Northwest cargo traffic down in Dec and year.

text.p: Northwest Airlines WEDNESDAY ITS said December and full-year 1996 cargo traffic were lower than 1995 levels.

Northwest said its full-year, systemwide decline in cargo ton miles (CTM) was 1.4 percent - from 2.246 billion CTM to 2.215 billion CTM. A 4.4 percent reduction in domestic cargo traffic more than offset a 0.6 percent rise in international tonne miles.
In December, system ton miles declined 3.6 percent, to 187 million from 194 million CTM in December 1995.
Internationally, cargo ton miles fell 4.6 percent last month, while domestic ton miles fell 2.0 percent, the airline said. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
